scope: Nine portal mosaics, nine doors, three rose windows, photographed capitals and distinct curved soffit fields.
geometry: Independent approximate architecture; source-visible fields reviewed E01–E13 against photographs. No whole facade or room backdrop.
rights: Rights remain with the credited authors. Per-record Wikimedia licenses are retained. Informer, TravelAnswer and forum photographic excerpts have no asserted open license.
processing: Bounded native photographic extracts, planar or curved UV placement, source-derived nonfigurative relief geometry. No generated saints, fabricated text or mirrored icons.
